title: Service of Notice
description: Service of notices required by the Act

steps.step: Delivering a copy of the notice to the opposite party or complainant
Transmitting a copy of the notice by registered post acknowledgment due
Transmitting a copy of the notice by speed post
Transmitting a copy of the notice by approved courier service
Transmitting a copy of the notice by electronic means or other mode of transmission of documents
Receipt of acknowledgment or receipt purporting to be signed by the opposite party or his agent or complainant by the District Commission, State Commission or National Commission
Receipt of postal article containing the notice back by the Commission with an endorsement of refusal to take delivery or accept the notice
Declaration by the Commission that the notice has been duly served on the opposite party or complainant

content.authority: District Commission, State Commission or National Commission
